purpose: Final broad-prose backlog tranche: CARICOM/UNHCR, three exact Colombia case/operation objects, Honduras CONADEH and Timor-Leste oversight/police identities.
identityRule: At low discovery priority, promote only stable referents with explicit dossier boundaries. ISO/source tokens, treaty/process acronyms, historical prose fragments and ambiguous institutional acronyms remain rejected or deferred.
explicitDeferrals: Bulgaria `FRA` remains deferred because the local text indicates an EU fundamental-rights source while `FRA` also collides with the France ISO token; no ambiguous global alias is created.
Swiss `CEDAW` and Tonga `CERD` remain treaty/treaty-body shorthand without forcing a committee identity where the wording does not distinguish treaty from body.
Nepal `Gen Z` remains an event/movement label rather than a first-class Project at this ontology granularity.
explicitNonGoals: Ratchet zero means zero unreviewed extractor candidates, not zero uncertainty.
No case/project object carries a governance outcome by identity.
Regional/UN organization identity does not propagate member/State conduct.
Deferred ambiguous acronyms remain explicit uncertainty rather than invented precision.
